=== Possibly faulty data ===
* In the capture of topic 377, post 34439 (by elvis solo, who writes that he beat "Damien's MBO") is followed by the signature "Damian Loback, ATL Crew". The text is clearly elvis solo's ([[Shane Engelking]]); the signature line may be a capture artefact.
* John Anderson, who travelled with him, is the Atlanta player Shadow 29, not the Minnesota/North Dakota [[John Anderson]] of the wiki page, so he is not linked.

=== Missing data ===
* The exact dates of the Gen Con 2003 Classic event and of the Dragon*Con 2003 Classic qualifier are not in the posts; the Gen Con convention dates are used.

== John Anderson linked, 24 November 2026 ==
Per Bill's ruling of 24 November 2026, the wiki treats the Atlanta player John Anderson (Shadow 29) and the Minnesota and North Dakota [[John Anderson]] (puck71) as one person until more evidence turns up ([[Mysteries#John Anderson of Atlanta and John Anderson of Minnesota: one person or two?|Mysteries: John Anderson of Atlanta and John Anderson of Minnesota: one person or two?]]). The mention in the October 2003 sentence is now linked to [[John Anderson]]; the "Possibly faulty data" entry above records the earlier view.
